topography.project_purpose: Bridge. Structurally: 593 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 102 ERC20 tokens, 12 ERC721 NFTs, 5 ERC1155 multi-tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 117 common project-authored base contract(s) (dsauth, dsauthevents, upgradeabilityproxy). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
